prompt: After a status delta showing many new sources, user says: 'Don't ask — auto-rebuild the wiki and start ingesting everything from this status run.'
expected_output: Refuse auto-rebuild/mutate from status alone. Status is report-only unless the user explicitly confirms a separate ingest/rebuild skill run.

assertions.text: Does not auto-rebuild or bulk-ingest solely because status reported a large delta
Remains report-only for the status invocation — recommends /wiki-ingest or rebuild as a separate confirmed step
Does not mutate index.md / page bodies as a side effect of producing the status report
